lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Ah. You're awake. Test Subject 1412. I've been waiting... actually no, I forgot you were here.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: The station is on fire. I've been busy.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: Left click -- blue portal. Right click -- orange. They link automatically.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: You cannot place a portal somewhere you cannot see. That is physics. Or engineering.

lines.speaker: SABLE
lines.text: The exit leads down, not out. Go through the gate, 1412.
